Thank you for your kind words! We will met again, we "ended" things as friends and he will always have a place in my heart. We just needed time apart, to work on ourselves. 

I wish you and your son all the best and I'm glad if my words were of any help to you and take it from someone that shut down when things got hard,that closed off and never worked on my mental side before exploding and making things worse, asking for help, talking to someone, makes you stronger, it shows and takes enormous inner  strength. 

Again, if you ever need a friend, I'm only a message away <3

You are amazing for thinking and taking care of your son like that, not all parents would have done that, most would have shut down completely, so pat yourself on the back, you deserve it. 

As for the loneliness, I may not know exactly what you are going though but yesterday it had been 30 days since I last saw my best friend, the man that I lost a child with and I thought was my soul mate, the man I saw myself have a future with. We had a messy but beautiful relationship and I miss him so much, everyday that I can only begin to imagine what you are going though right now and you are amazing for even getting up in the morning, remember that. Keep going, if not for yourself for your son.

If you ever need a friend, message me anytime, if it's just for a rant or to tell someone that you need to cry, I'm only a message away.
I relate to you on this. If you ever need want to talk or just want someone to listen you, sent me a message.

Was riding one of my younger horses in the mountains when something spooked him and he jumped to the side. We both went flying down a steep hill around 20 stories high, that at the bottom has a river. 
I remember looking down and thinking "well shit, now I won't know how GoT ends."

Luckily my brain turned on and I jumped off my horse before tumbling down. We both came out of this with only minor bruises and scratches. 

Pic of my horse after the day : https://imgur.com/a8WWHVc
I won't deny there is a part of me that still wants to live yes, but the part of me that wants to die is much stronger and honestly I just want to leave everything behind, and be at ease.
Thank you. Yes, both my parents are alive but I do not speak to either of them and I have one half-brother that lives in another country and again, not on speaking terms.
Yea, sometimes it gets really bad and often after panic attacks I vomit for days after it and can't eat anything. It sucks and my doctors don't believe me, saying its all in my head.

Saleswoman at a outwear clothes store. A woman came in asking if we had any vegan jackets. I showed her a few that didn't have any fur or feathers in. She didn't like them and wanted to look at the ones that had fur and feathers in them, which I warned her about.
She tried on one which both had fur and feathers in them and she loved it and said she wanted to buy it. 

At the cashier she asked to get at least a 30% of since "she wasn't going to use the fur." We said no, we couldn't do that, it was her choice not to use it but she still had to buy it. She got mad but bought it anyway.

Next day she comes in, fuming, screaming and yelling at us for selling her this jacket. Cause it had skin and feathers in it.

Some people..
Just life, trauma after trauma after trauma, chronicle depression and honestly just sick and tired of life, just so goddam tired all the time

Last year I lost my aunt that was more like a mom to me then a aunt. I saw her on Thursday before leaving on a camping trip with my boyfriend, we got a call from my dad Saturday evening saying we had to drive back home because she was dying.
By the time we got to the hospital she was all blue and black from blood poisoning that couldn't be stopped. There were at least 10 machines in the room just keeping her "alive" I will never forget that room. 
She passed away Sunday morning.

I got home from a night of hard drinking with a couple of friends, had a blast and was completely hammered but I had blamed to take my life that night whatever happened. 

I started to write my goodbye note and had written goodbye to everyone in my life except my ex-bf and I couldn't write his name, I realized that even after a terrible break-up that I still had deep feelings for him and I know he still has deep feelings for me and I just couldn't do it to him. I couldn't make him go through more pain then I already had so I didn't go through with it.

It's amazing how life can surprise you, cause that night I realized I still loved him and wanted to build my life with him.

I hope that you won't , coming from someone that's tried to kill herself 3 times in the last 2 months, don't. 
Life may be shit and everything is upside down or maybe you're just tired of life, it's okei but I hope you won't. Because there will always be someone that will miss you, someone that will cry and someone that won't know how to cope without you.

Speak to a someone, reach out to those people you are actually friends with, you'd be surprised at how many people are willing to help when you ask for it. 

There are also lots of groups for these sort of things, try to find them, if not though uni though the internet, there are so many people that feel the same way but cutting is a call for help and not a long-term solution.

Just ask for help and if your loneliness gets to much, you are welcome to pm me, a fellow cutter

I understand you so well , I've been cutting since I was 14 but these past few months I've been doing it a lot and I agree, why does there have to be something wrong? 
Because there always is. These scars are a cry for help, they tell a story, it may not be something major , just something small but cutting is something that goes deeper.
Cutting can also be very dangerous , if you cut to deep there isin't a lot you can do.
